menu_theme_loop.role: Main menu, character select, options, partner select and the other front-end menus
menu_theme_loop.notes: 30 bars at 125 BPM is 57.6 seconds. The file was cut on zero crossings with a short overlap so the musical loop is seamless. FFmpeg's MP3 priming is 1105 samples (start time 0.023021s). Playback decodes to an AudioBuffer and sets loopStart/loopEnd so the loop is 57.6s.

ui_select.role: Every menu move, confirm, open, close, character choice and cancel
ui_select.notes: Soft bassy UI click. Each press starts its own one-shot so fast navigation overlaps instead of restarting the sample.
